text.tspan: Hi! I'm Pyramid.
I code random stuff for fun, because I can
My two biggest projects
What I code with
A game that emerged from a CS final
exam about cubes vs circles that took
me on a wild ride down game
development lane, in which I paused
development on to focus on the
underlying roots of game development,
to structure it better. Most classes from
this project were directly imported into
Vedge, the video game engine that will
make the next Cubegame edition.
6,653 lines of Java
1 dependency: JavaFX
Only 2 years in
The main/current branch
org.py.cgjfxe
Snake Bot
A Discord bot built from Discord.JS
that I poured my heart into, which is
still in development today in Alpha
stages. This project is my only "active"
project to the world, and is currently in
about 45 servers at the time of typing
this. This project was a little more
successful than Cubegame, because it
was built on years of experience with
developing bots, and I am pretty
happy with how it turned out!
